about.title: Groupe L'Agence
about.description: Groupe L'Agence supports you with complete tourism and ticketing solutions, bringing together tickets, hotels and essential services for stress-free travel.

items.description: Save time by comparing all flights in one place.

items.title: 3 & 4 star hotel bookings
items.description: Enjoy comfortable stays at the best price.

items.title: Personalised travel assistance
items.description: Simplify your travel preparation.

trust.heading: Access the best deals on
trust.description: We give you access to thousands of flights and accommodations at the best rates, with complete transparency. Flights and hotels together to save you time, save you money and give you a seamless experience.

services.heading: Travel with
services.description: Carefully managed organisation for comfortable and secure journeys.

items.subtitle: Our partners

items.description2: Thanks to our partners, easily find the ideal options for your trip.

items.description2: Compare all available flights and choose the one that suits you best.

items.subtitle: Selected accommodation
items.title: Hotel bookings
items.description: Enjoy 3 and 4 star hotels selected for comfort, location and value for money.
items.description2: Each place offers the right balance between quality, ideal location and price.

items.subtitle: Mobility on site
items.title: Car rental
items.description: Move freely thanks to our wide choice of vehicles, from economy to premium.
items.description2: Transparent rates, simplified pick-up and a service available at the airport as well as in the city for all your journeys.

servicesExtra.heading: Our best
servicesExtra.description: Additional solutions to simplify every aspect of your journey.

items.title: Secure transactions
items.description: Cards, mobile money or cash. Pay however you like, in complete security.

items.title: Travel insurance
items.description: In partnership with a trusted insurance provider, enjoy cover tailored to your needs.

items.title: Visas & documents
items.description: Get dedicated assistance with all visa formalities, simplifying your travel preparation.

items.title: Car rental
items.description: Rent the vehicle suited to your stay, with or without a driver, available at the airport or in the city.

ctaFinal.heading: Ready to plan your
ctaFinal.description: Tickets, hotels and complementary services brought together so you can fully enjoy every step.

engagement.heading: Every journey deserves to be
engagement.description: Flights, hotels and car rental: we bring together the essentials of your journey with a single point of contact. Our team supports you at every step, from the first quote until your return.

contact.heading: Let's plan
contact.description: Our team of experts is at your disposal to answer all your questions and help you organise the trip of your dreams.

footer.tagline: Your trusted partner for all your journeys.

intro.heading: Car
intro.description: Groupe L'Agence offers a complete range of vehicles for all your travel, with flexible solutions tailored to your needs, whether solo, as a family or in a group.

items.title: Wide choice of vehicles
items.description: From economical city cars to premium vehicles, find the model that suits you.

items.title: With or without a driver
items.description: Choose the freedom of driving yourself or enjoy a professional driver.

items.title: Flexible pick-up
items.description: Collect your vehicle at the airport, in the city or at the address of your choice.

advantages.heading: Rent with peace of
advantages.description: Our advantages for a stress-free rental, from departure to return.

items.title: Flexible cancellation
items.description: Change or cancel your booking with no hidden fees.
